slides.title: rights groups ask UN for a special session on Ethiopia

slides.text: In an open letter dated **Oct 8**, **Amnesty, HRW** and others urge the **UN Human Rights Council** to meet urgently on Ethiopia.
They ask for **three independent experts** to assess abuses by **all parties** and report before **Jan 31, 2027**.
The letter also asks Ethiopia's government to give **experts access** to the country. Its claims are not independently verified here.
**Protect civilians, support independent investigations.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Amnesty International open letter, Oct 9, 2026
